landingPage.heroTitle: Fuwari blog template with search and themes
landingPage.heroDescription: A colourful open-source Astro blog with site search, archives, rich code blocks and a theme colour picker, deployed on Hostinger at a reviewed version.
landingPage.about: Fuwari is a popular open-source static blog template built with Astro and Tailwind CSS by its original author. It gives writers and developers a polished, illustrated blog with almost no setup. Posts are written in Markdown, with highlighted and collapsible code blocks and math formulas for technical writing. Readers search the whole site, browse a dated archive, and filter by category or tag, while a sidebar shows your profile and links. The theme switches between light and dark, and a colour slider lets you retint the whole site to match your style. Everything builds to static pages from your Markdown files. Hostinger deploys the original project at a version we have checked, with its MIT license.

features.title: Site search
features.description: A search index is built with the site, so readers can search every post instantly.

features.title: Rich code blocks
features.description: Highlighted code with line numbers, collapsible sections and copy buttons.

features.title: Math support
features.description: Write formulas in Markdown and they render as clean math on the page.

features.title: Archive, categories and tags
features.description: Readers browse posts by date, category or tag from any page.

features.title: Theme colour picker
features.description: Light and dark modes plus a hue slider that recolours the whole site.

features.title: Profile sidebar
features.description: Show your avatar, a short bio and social links next to every post.

landingPage.metaDescription: Start a polished personal blog with Fuwari: site search, archives, tags, rich code blocks and a theme colour picker, built with Astro. Deploy it on Hostinger.
